name: eReleases
summary: Press release distribution and writing service for small businesses, sending releases over PR Newswire and to targeted journalist lists.
best_for: small businesses that want a single press release sent over a national newswire with a targeted journalist list and are happy to pay per release
skip_if: you need a monthly plan with many releases, you only want cheap syndication, or you want results we have tested ourselves instead of the vendor's own claims
honest_knock: This is a per-release service, not software, so there is no ongoing plan or free trial. Add-ons cost $150 or more each, the page shows no refund terms, and the claims about reach and results are the vendor's own and we did not verify them.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Buzz Builder · one-off, Per press release distributed: Buzz Builder $399 (400 words, 1 industry list), Newsmaker $499 (500 words, 2 lists), PR Pro $699 (600 words, 3 lists, influencer email send)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-12 on ereleases.com/pricing, US dollars) eReleases sells press release distribution by the release, not by subscription. Buzz Builder costs $399 and covers 400 words and 1 industry target list. Newsmaker costs $499 and covers 500 words and 2 industry target lists, and the page marks it as the company's number one pick. PR Pro costs $699 and covers 600 words, 3 industry target lists and a direct email send to journalists, bloggers and influencers. All three include 2 images, editorial review and distribution through PR Newswire. Extras cost more: additional words are $150 per block of 100 words or part of a block, each additional industry list is $150, local saturation is $150, embedding images is $150, embedding a YouTube video is $200, and distribution to a single country is $150 or $1,000 for global. Having eReleases write the release costs $300 when added to a distribution package, with turnaround the page gives as under a week. The page says first-time customers save 30% and that bulk packages of 2 or more releases are available; we did not see the bulk prices. The page states no refund terms. We did not place an order, so we do not know the tax added.

compare_with.name: HubSpot
